This is the forest's stated even/odd resting rotation, not an unexplained closure. No 'Walkup Only' label on any page.

note: Six grass sites in the open clearing of the old Sand Spring CCC camp, off Sand Spring Road half a mile from Little Bear Creek Road (about 5 miles up from PA 87 north of Montoursville). 122 stands apart at the north end, a large full-sun back-in (100 by 70 ft); the other five sit close together along one lane, back-in or parallel, with 124 and 125 sharing a driveway and pads from 36 by 24 ft to 70 by 36 ft under 25 to 30 ft of overhead clearance. The agency says the sites were not designed for RVs, though its campsite map layer calls 122 and 125 suitable for a large trailer or RV. A tent-only site (121) is alongside. No toilet, no tables or fire rings on the agency's map layer. Pack out trash. --Claude
